provenance.density: Mass-weighted CIC deposition of simulation stellar particles with authored offline Gaussian smoothing.

photo.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever (Montana State University) Acknowledgment: Image processing: Travis Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage), Mahdi Zamani & Davide de Martin

display.alignment: Authored lab alignment, not an astrometric fit between the simulation and photograph.
display.color: Fixed orthographic RGB constraint from an authored observational image; color is not simulated stellar population synthesis.
display.dust: No dust or extinction is encoded; alpha is stellar-density support.
display.brightness: Authored mass-to-light conversion and exposure; not calibrated photometry.

approximation.method: Filtered scalar fields; decoded after filtering; integrated emission/absorption; symmetric slab attenuation; exponential energy in ordinary alpha.
limitations: Ordinary alpha approximates emitted light and wavelength-dependent extinction.
Finite slices and axis handoffs approximate a continuous field; angle-dependent opacity and sampling differences remain.
No runtime ray integration, near-field noise or global HDR display pass.
